title: GEO GSE96583 PBMC IFN-beta biological hard truth targets vs confirmed nulls and Decision Curve Analysis
claim_target: Audited donor-aware pseudobulk DE controls empirical FDR <= 0.05 on hard biological truth targets and yields strictly superior decision-theoretic net benefit over naive cell-level pseudoreplication.
claim_exclusions: causal mechanism claims without genetic intervention controls

locked_endpoints.empirical_fdr_control: empirical FDR on verified biological targets must be <= 0.05
locked_endpoints.decision_net_benefit: audited pipeline net benefit must exceed naive pipeline across threshold probabilities (0.05, 0.4)
locked_endpoints.null_uniformity: null p-value distribution KS uniformity test p-value must be >= 0.01
